description: A searchable command menu that opens in a dialog on desktop and a drawer on mobile.
overview:
`CommandPalette` hosts a `Command` list inside a `Dialog` on desktop, positioned in the upper third of the viewport, and inside a bottom `Drawer` with a swipe handle below the `48rem` breakpoint. Fill `CommandPaletteContent` with `CommandInput`, `CommandList`, `CommandGroup`, `CommandItem` and the other `Command` parts.

A global keyboard shortcut toggles the palette: `Cmd+K` on macOS and `Ctrl+K` elsewhere by default. Use it for app-wide search and quick actions.
usage: The palette can be controlled with `open` and `onOpenChange` or uncontrolled with `defaultOpen`; the hotkey and the trigger update the same state. Set `hotkey` to another letter to change the shortcut, or to `false` to disable it. `CommandPaletteTrigger` accepts `render` to use your own button, for example a `Button` with a `Kbd` hint. Remaining props on `CommandPaletteContent` pass through to `Command`.

examples.WithCloseButton: Shows an icon close button with `showCloseButton`.
examples.WithCloseLabel: Shows a text close button labelled Cancel with `closeLabel`.
examples.Floating: Insets the mobile drawer from the screen edges with `floating`.

parts.CommandPalette: The root that renders a `Dialog` on desktop and a `Drawer` on mobile and registers the hotkey.
parts.CommandPaletteTrigger: The button that opens the palette.
parts.CommandPaletteContent: The popup that wraps a `Command` with a visually hidden title and description.

CommandPalette.onOpenChange: Called when the palette opens or closes, including through the hotkey.
CommandPalette.hotkey: The letter that toggles the palette together with `Cmd` on macOS or `Ctrl` elsewhere; `false` disables it.
CommandPalette.floating: Insets the mobile drawer from the screen edges with fully rounded corners.

CommandPaletteTrigger.render: Replaces the default button element with your own element, such as a `Button`.

CommandPaletteContent.title: Accessible name of the dialog, rendered visually hidden.
CommandPaletteContent.description: Accessible description of the dialog, rendered visually hidden.
CommandPaletteContent.showCloseButton: Shows a close button in the corner of the popup.
CommandPaletteContent.closeLabel: Replaces the close icon with this text; requires `showCloseButton`.

accessibility:
- The popup is a `dialog` named by `title` and described by `description`.
- Opening the palette focuses the search input, and the first enabled option is selected.
- Arrow keys move between options and skip disabled ones; typing filters the list.
- `Escape` closes the palette and returns focus to the trigger.
notes: Parts carry `data-slot` values `command-palette`, `command-palette-trigger` and `command-palette-content`. On mobile the list is capped at `60dvh` and the input gains end padding when a close button is shown. `className` on `CommandPaletteContent` applies to the inner `Command`, not the dialog or drawer.
